rationale: The objective requires ranking denial codes, understanding missingness across 11,559 null denial codes, and segmenting denial rates by all five specified dimensions. Using 'all_claims' scope with 'by_status' quantification of missing codes directly addresses the question of how many claims carry no denial code and where codes are absent. The retrieved skill on adjudicated claims ensures denominator correctness by excluding pending claims, supporting statistical discipline and reproducibility. All five segments (claim_type, provider_specialty, network_status, place_of_service, auth_required_flag) are included as specified in the objective. Flagging groups with fewer than 30 claims addresses the 'small_groups' tag and supports careful interpretation. Report caveats and detailed denominators reinforce transparency and analytical rigor.
